name: glm53_kpool_short_decode_layout
purpose: Make eager short-decode indices equal the general-path layout. Keep general decode, prefill, and MTP index sharing unchanged.
base_image_note: The recorded glm53_kpool_tail_slot_mapping image. This patch carries its runner and MTP mapper edits without changes.

build.builder_note: PrismaBuild refuses daemon-side Docker builds. The Dockerfile runs inside an owned Kaniko container with the admitted CPU and memory limits.
build.command: Run the pinned Kaniko image with --context=dir:///context --dockerfile=/context/Dockerfile --insecure-registry=192.168.1.107 --destination=192.168.1.107/prismaquant/spark-vllm-nccl230:c2e75e03-kpoolidx1631. Mount this directory at /context.
build.self_check: The Docker RUN checks all short rows on CPU. It also checks the patched indexer hash and eight unchanged or carried source hashes.
build.contents: Two patch scripts under /opt/glm53 and one changed vLLM source file. No runtime source tree or new serving dependency.

edits.what: Replace the short-decode helper with the fixed history region and incomplete-pool tail region. Keep the unpooled causal path.
Pass index_kpool at the existing decode fast-path call.

qualification.model: Synthetic decode rows with GLM-5.3 geometry, top-k 2048, and pool size 4
checks_passed: Base GPU action 800a707ad64d5fce88ed842b00ff576a9f1d631c5ba40912b61346745fcfb4ef proves ascending pool order for every short length.
That base action fails row equality at 1536 lengths. The patched action f6d62786 passes every length 0 through 2048.
The patched action also captures persistent_topk and expansion. Replay with reversed lengths still equals the eager fast-path rows.
The Dockerfile self-check passes on CPU for every short length and all recorded source hashes.
CPU action 484265fa passes nine layout and base-byte refusal cases. Action c8bdea80 passes seventeen patch-set cases.
Metadata projection 39c84048 verifies the three completed latency arms, their profiler traces, and Netdata series from both Sparks.
not_qualified: This record qualifies index rows, not a served model. It admits no positive model layer count.
The eager versus FULL_DECODE_ONLY draft comparison remains blocked by Tessera's branch_plan guard for MTP k=2 at max_model_len 4096.
Tessera issue 695 must qualify that drafter metadata before this image can receive FULL serving evidence.
Client ITL includes HTTP streaming overhead. One latency serve per arm does not establish a speed or energy ranking.
The 45-layer body, TP2, padded capture lists, and contexts above 2048 tokens have no new qualification.

latency.limit: One serve per latency arm. These are observed client intervals, not a statistically qualified runtime ranking.

profile.limit: Netdata windows include startup and requests. No energy ranking follows from these windows.
